It is located in [[Shimotsuke Province]].

== History ==
It was founded in {{ill|806|ab|806|af|806|als|806|am|806 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|806|ar|806|ary|806|ast|806|az|806|azb|۸۰۶ (میلادی)|bar|806|bcl|806|be|806|be_x_old|806|bg|806|bn|৮০৬|bpy|মারি ৮০৬|br|806|bs|806.|ca|806|cdo|806 nièng|ceb|806|ckb|٨٠٦|crh|806|cs|806|csb|806|cv|806|cy|806|da|806|de|806|el|806|eml|806|eo|806|es|806|et|806|eu|806|fa|۸۰۶ (میلادی)|fi|806|fo|806|fr|806|frr|806|fy|806|ga|806|gan|806年|gd|806|gl|806|he|806|hi|806|hr|806.|ht|806 (almanak jilyen)|hu|806|hy|806|id|806|ilo|806|io|806|is|806|it|806|ja|806年|jv|806|ka|806|kaa|806|kk|806 жыл|ko|806년|la|806|lb|806|lij|806|lmo|806|lt|806 m.|lv|806. gads|map_bms|806|mdf|806|mg|806|mhr|806|mk|806|mr|इ.स. ८०६|mrj|806 и|ms|806|mzn|۸۰۶|nah|806|nap|806|nds|806|new|सन् ८०६|nl|806|nn|806|no|806|nrm|806|nso|806|oc|806|or|୮୦୬|os|806-æм аз|pl|806|pt|806|qu|806|ro|806|ru|806 год|rue|806|sa|८०६|scn|806|sd|806ع|se|806|sh|806.|shn|806|si|806|sk|806|sl|806|smn|806|sq|806|sr|806|su|806|sv|806|sw|806|tg|Соли 806|th|พ.ศ. 1349|tk|806|tl|806|tly|806|tr|806|tt|806 ел|uk|806|ur|806ء|uz|806|vec|806|vi|806|vls|806|war|806|wuu|806年|xmf|806|zh|806年|zh_min_nan|806 nî|zh_yue|806年|qid=Q30021}} ({{ill|Daidō|Q1373191|qid=Q1373191|lt=Daidō}} 1). It is also a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} in the {{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}<ref name="散歩">Editorial Committee for Historical Walks in Tochigi (ed.), ''A Historical Walk of Tochigi Prefecture (Historical Walk 9)'', Yamakawa Publishing, 2007, pp.73-74</ref>.

In the {{ill|Middle Ages|Q12554|qid=Q12554}}, it was protected by the {{ill|Takemu clan|Q11546315|qid=Q11546315}}, local lords of the area. In the {{ill|Edo period|ar|فترة إيدو|ast|Periodu Edo|az|Edo dövrü|bcl|Panahon nin Edo|be|Перыяд Эда|bg|Едо (период)|bn|এদো যুগ|bo|ཨེ་དོའི་དུས་སྐབས།|br|Marevezh Edo|ca|Període Edo|ckb|سەردەمی ئێدۆ|cs|Období Edo|cv|Эдо тапхăрĕ|da|Edo-perioden|de|Edo-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Edo|es|Período Edo|et|Edo ajastu|eu|Edo aroa|fa|دوره ادو|fi|Edo-kausi|fr|Époque d'Edo|gl|Período Edo|he|תקופת אדו|hi|एदो अवधी|hr|Edo (razdoblje)|hu|Edo-kor|id|Zaman Edo|is|Jedótímabilið|it|Periodo Edo|ja|江戸時代|jv|Jaman Édo|ko|에도 시대|lt|Edo laikotarpis|lv|Edo periods|mk|Едо (период)|mn|Эдогийн эрин|ms|Zaman Edo|nl|Edoperiode|nn|Edotida|oc|Periòde Edo|pl|Edo (okres)|pt|Período Edo|ro|Perioada Edo|ru|Период Эдо|simple|Edo period|sk|Obdobie Edo|sl|Obdobje Edo|sq|Periudha Edo|sr|Едо период|su|Période Edo|sv|Edoperioden|th|ยุคเอโดะ|tl|Panahong Edo|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Eto|tr|Edo Dönemi|uk|Період Едо|ur|ایڈو دور|uz|Edo davri|vi|Thời kỳ Edo|war|Panahon Edo|wuu|江戶時代|zh|江户时代|zh_min_nan|Edo sî-tāi|zh_yue|江戶時代|qid=Q184963}} it was managed by {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=shugenja}}, but under the 9th lord of the {{ill|Mito Domain|Q1146904|qid=Q1146904}}, {{ill|Tokugawa Nariaki|Q1323770|qid=Q1323770}}, it was changed to {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yuiitsu Shinto}}<ref name="散歩"></ref>.

Its former {{ill|Saijin|Q11591100|qid=Q11591100}} was {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|Q272993|qid=Q272993|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto}}, but now they are {{ill|Yamato Takeru|Q461258|qid=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru-no-Mikoto}} and {{ill|Kanayama-hiko and Kanayama-hime|Q4387856|qid=Q4387856|lt=Kanayamahiko-no-Mikoto}}<ref name="散歩"></ref>.
